a.text: The same game of weiqi... one that you have lost countless times over the centuries.
You are trying to fight the whole with its parts... all well-laid plans no more than child's play in my eyes.
Drowning yourself in children's toys. A bad old habit of yours.
This challenge is simply a repetition of the thousands of defeats of the past.

steps.text: ...Hah.
You try to mask your fear with arrogance.
Why bother?
Anger, fear, hope... I see clearly in you the things you try to see in me.
Join the game, if you're not afraid.
This time...
You WILL lose.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I am defeated.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I did not expect this variation of the offset play.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You had a chance, if you did not continue to cede ground in the center around the hundredth move, hoping for a draw.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I did not have a clear view of the developments to come, so I picked the safe move. I see I was mistaken.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Haha. I thought my weiqi skills had improved, but it looks like I'm still far beneath you.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: In this last battle, we were only able to avoid heavy casualties thanks to your strategy of conserving our strength and luring the enemy deep in.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: This return to the capital is an opportunity for you to rest. But I expect it will be a long time until our next meeting.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You don't seem concerned with victory or defeat.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Why obsess over such things in a meeting between brothers?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Not just weiqi. It seems that nothing ever concerns you; you are always content to act the part of the kind benefactor.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I don't know why you'd say that...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The new Right Assistant Minister of the Ministry of War, together with officials from the Ministry of Rites, accused you in a petition to the throne two months ago.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Commanding troops to act without authorization. A serious crime.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: How do you know the imperial court's business, when you've been with me on the front lines for the past six months?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I have my ways. You should worry about yourself.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: If he meant our late return to camp, it was because we had to stop and wait for a Catastrophe to pass.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: General Yang knew. The Ministry of War hardly has a case.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Oh, you don't need to worry about that.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The Assistant Minister was found to have accepted bribes and embezzled supplies... he is in prison now, awaiting trial.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: He won't spread rumors any longer for now. As for whether he makes it out of prison alive... only Heaven knows.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: You promised to stop meddling in the affairs of the court.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I would hardly call it meddling. Simply helping Yan rid itself of a corrupt official.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: You know your own intentions...

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: You see the entire court as a game of weiqi, with human lives for stones?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Has your lust for honesty and righteousness blinded you to the evil and malice lurking in the hearts of people?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No sooner had that man taken office than he started to target you. Do you really think there is no one behind the curtain? Do you really believe we have only one enemy?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Go easy on this one, and we set ourselves up for more trouble to come.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Strange things have been happening since the birth of our youngest brother.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Fāng's patient committed suicide after getting better.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Someone has been producing 'satirical' works of falsehood in Dusk's name, imitating her touch.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Thieves have stolen treasures from Yi's garden. A long and thorough investigation by the Judicial Review Office turned up nothing more than a gang of fools.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And then, your matter.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We all know... It is not dead.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The people here have never forgotten Its terror. That is why they watch our every move, every meeting.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Do you still think your little achievements will force them to see us as anything more than alien entities, enemies to be feared?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Are Fāng and Dusk alright?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Fāng was depressed for a while. Dusk has always been how she is. But I don't suppose either would worry too much about it.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But what about the future?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: You think someone is pulling the strings behind the scenes?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: The Shanhaizhong, or someone else with ulterior motives?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: That's what I truly fear.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: If a single mastermind is behind all of this...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I cannot determine who it might be, nor do I have any inkling of their intentions.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I will confirm all that you've said with the Sui Regulator.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: ...I know you have good intentions.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: But don't overstep the boundaries like this again.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Since when have we been worried for one another?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I simply didn't want to fall into a trap without knowing who dug it.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It's time to go.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: The journey is far. Be careful on your way.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Bring the others my greetings.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: ...I may not see them.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: *sigh*.
The proxy bids his sibling farewell and proceeds in the direction of the capital.
The journey is far, and he is in a hurry. He does not have time to stop for small noises along the way.
One wrong move...
And all is lost...
Let's begin with the name 'Yu', shall we?
Sure. Let me think...
Yu Yin Rao Liang.' The sound lingers upon the beams.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Liang. Liang...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: ...What idiom begins with 'Liang'?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Don't tell me you're giving up already.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: O-Of course not. Just busy with the beastmeat. Give me some time.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Sure... I have many books to copy. Take your time.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Liang... I feel like I should ask Yi, but he's not here...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Heng Liang'—crossbeam. 'Fang Liang'—roof beam. 'Dong Liang'—pillar. I know! 'Dong Liang Zhi Cai,' pillar of society!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Wait, it has to start with Liang...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: (Say, she has so many bamboo slips with words on them sitting next to her. Maybe if I took a peek...)

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: —N-Nothing.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Why are you copying the words from the slips onto these... squares?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: It's called 'paper'. A new invention.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: It's lighter and easier to write on than bamboo. It also doesn't deteriorate easily, which makes it easy to preserve.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: You can preserve something forever, if you write it on paper?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Yes and no.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Bamboo slips may last for decades, paper for centuries.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Be it bamboo or paper, however, there ultimately comes a day when it perishes.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: No matter what we use to record something, it will only endure forever if people truly commit it to memory.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Just like how people remember your cooking when they taste it.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Hm...
He listens, but it is unclear if he understands. He scratches his head beside the stockbeast that he has just butchered, but he cannot come up with an idiom that starts with 'Liang'.
Suddenly, a small piece of bamboo falls in front of him, and he sees the words on it.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Liang Shang Jun Zi'—man on the roof beam!

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Not bad. 'Zi', eh? Let me think... 'Zi Xu—'

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Let's stop here. This word chain game is so hard. Why don't you play it with Ling and Dusk the next time they're here, and I'll watch from the sidelines.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Are you hungry? Do you want me to cook the meat?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Can I have the bamboo slips, if you don't need them anymore?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: For the fire? I suppose...
The young proxy takes the bamboo slips from his sister and skillfully cuts them down the middle...
Into long, sharp sticks.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: What are you making?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Meat skewers!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: This stockbeast tenderloin is just the right mix of lean and fat, and the fat on its belly is nice and firm. It'll taste great roasted.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: The fuel has to be charcoal. These bamboo slips don't burn for long.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I already have the charcoal. We can start roasting when I'm done cutting the slips and skewering the meat.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Hah... does grilling meat on bamboo slips make this a scholar's meal?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Let's call it 'scholar's barbecue'!

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Well, I trust your cooking. I'm excited to try it.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Well, I'm done with the slips. You can take them.
You're both here.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Oh... back already?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Wang?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I got your letter. I thought you wouldn't be here for a few more days, at least.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Smooth trip?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You two...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: There's the idiom 'burning a guqin to cook a fowlbeast,' which means sacrilegious, wasteful behavior.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: What are you doing with these bamboo slips?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I-I'm not...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Jie gave them to me...
The boy hides behind his sister, peeking his head out from her side.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Just giving some broken bamboo slips to Yu to make the most of them. Why so harsh?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: You should be more grateful to Yu for making dinner.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It's not like I actually said anything...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Don't fight, don't fight!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I'll go make dinner! It's not every day my second-oldest brother comes back. We finally get to eat together!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: You, just, er, sit down and chat!

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: He's always been a little afraid of you. Can't you be more gentle?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Are things not going well?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: But we don't get together very often, and Yu misses you.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Anything you want to say can wait until after dinner.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: So, unsettling things have been happening without my knowledge.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You don't look worried at all.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I'm worried... and I'm just surprised that you show so much concern for your siblings, brother.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Siblings in the sense that we were born from the same fragmented consciousness. Not true blood relations.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We each have our own interests and ambitions. Our fates are none of each other's concern... we walk different paths.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Do you truly think so?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: My views are different.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: See, it's been centuries since we came to the mortal world. Even if we are not truly part of it, most of the scenes and people that we see are lovely.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: But the people we meet seem to become smoke in the wind in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: In the end, it is only 'us' who remain, and it's only in each other that we can truly speak our hearts.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: We may have differences and we may have conflicts, but we could never cut each other off completely... isn't that very much like human siblings?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I have no intention of arguing, if this is how you think.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: *sigh*... I don't know why you always seem so aloof. We don't see each other very often. Are you not happy at all?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I wonder if you'd regret it, if one of us suddenly disappeared forever.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Speaking of which, I encountered something strange recently.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: One night, I was about to go to bed when I heard a sound from the study.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: From the garden, I saw through the window the silhouette of someone bending over the desk, writing something.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I hurried into the study to find no one, only the Jijiuzhang that I had been transcribing the past few days lying on the desk, with scribblings all over it...

spans.text: I hurried into the study to find no one, only the
that I had been transcribing the past few days lying on the desk, with scribblings all over it...

steps.text: Jie takes a scroll from the desk.
One word is written over every neatly written character on the page.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Who do you think could have done it?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: There is only one possibility.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It is awakening, and It is attempting to interfere with us in some way.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We thought Its consciousness had completely faded after Yu's birth.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But It is alive... still sleeping, but the stuff of our nightmares.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: If It does wake, we will become Its fleeting dream...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: What do you have in mind?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I don't know yet. But I'll think of a way...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I have an idea, if you'd care to listen.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I only recently thought about it... when I compiled the histories with the people of Yan, there were inevitably some mistakes, no matter how careful we were.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Unlike ordinary writing, it takes great effort to correct mistakes written in the histories.
Jie picks up a writing knife from the desk, used to scrape bamboo slips, then picks up a scroll, and gently scrapes the paper.

The ink that has seeped into the paper, even smearing the next page slightly, disappears without a trace when the writing knife touches it. The paper is blank, as though nothing has ever been written on it.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: This knife...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I think my influence has changed it.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I have a faint feeling that the words it scrapes away—a history, or at least... a name—don't just disappear from the paper; they disappear from people's hearts and minds.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Perhaps there will come a day when we use it to scrape the word 'Sui' from all the texts of this world.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You can... do that?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Not yet. Right now, it's only a writing knife, albeit an unusual one.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: But I can feel it. The more words written, the heavier my knife and pen become.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Perhaps we're all the same. We discovered the answer to who we are in that primordial void, then we understood the meaning of our existence in the mortal realm. This is what proves we are different from It.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Perhaps there will come a day when our strength exceeds Its. Then, we can truly break free of Its influence, and live as 'ourselves'.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: As long as we don't forget who we are, of course.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: What are you thinking on, brother?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: *sigh*... Sometimes I feel like you and I are the least compatible, amongst our siblings.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Plots and plans are things to be kept inside one's heart, but words and language are for expressing what lies in one's heart.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: But sometimes I feel like you hide nothing from me, that I can see all that you think.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Interesting, isn't it? We both found what we wanted to devote ourselves to, only to have it reshape our personalities in return.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Shu always says I'm obsessed with the past. And I remember the deathly white that she talked about, which lies at the end of the future.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: She was right. One cannot pretend to be carefree, when there are things that one cannot let go of.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I know you're worried about the unknowable future... victory and defeat are what you're most obsessed about, but it would be such a miserable existence, if there was nothing but victory and defeat.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Besides that, what is it you care about the most?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I do not obsess about victory and defeat. I simply...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I simply do not like to accept that a game could not be won.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: By the way, are you reporting to the Sui Regulator tomorrow? Could you take these copied books with you? They'll need to review them before they can be archived in the Sky Mirror Pavilion.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: And take another look at the re-copied Jijiuzhang for me. Bring the writing knife too, so you can correct any mistakes.

spans.text: And take another look at the re-copied
for me. Bring the writing knife too, so you can correct any mistakes.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Anything you've written hardly needs me to check it.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Consider it an activity to pass the time.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: You spend so much time devising military strategies, thinking of victory and defeat. A distraction would do you good.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: And perhaps, you might find what you're looking for in the text.
